reasoning.title: How I worked the question

steps.label: Decompose
steps.summary: Split into efficacy, durability, safety, and population impact.
steps.detail: Each sub-question needs a different evidence bar, RCTs for efficacy, real-world claims data for population effect.

steps.label: Source
steps.summary: Prioritize Phase 3 RCTs and guideline bodies over press coverage.
steps.detail: Ranked 38 candidates by study design, sample size, and recency; demoted anything secondary.

steps.label: Cross-check
steps.summary: Require two independent sources before stating a number as fact.
steps.detail: A single trial sets a hypothesis; a <mark>replication or meta-analysis</mark> promotes it to a claim.

steps.label: Caveat
steps.summary: Separate trial-population results from real-world adherence.

reasoning.conclusion: Efficacy is strongly supported; population impact is plausible but unproven until persistence improves.
reasoning.footer: Reasoning is shown so you can audit the chain, not just the answer.

modelcompare.title: Three models, one prompt
modelcompare.prompt: Did GLP-1 drugs cure the obesity epidemic? Answer with evidence.

outputs.text: No "cure," but a <mark>genuine inflection</mark>: ~15% weight loss in trials, modest population reach so far. Cited 11 RCTs.
GLP-1 drugs have <mark>largely solved</mark> obesity for those who take them, reversing decades of rising rates.
Yes, semaglutide and tirzepatide are <mark>effective cures</mark> with few downsides.

modelcompare.footer: The graded pipeline is the only one that refused the word "cure", and cited why.

tokenstream.footer: Low-confidence tokens are where the hedging lives, hover to see what I almost said.

whatchanged.title: What changed after I read the payer data
whatchanged.before: GLP-1 drugs are reversing the obesity epidemic at population scale.
whatchanged.after: GLP-1 drugs work powerfully per-patient, but population impact is gated by adherence and access.

diff.c: GLP-1 drugs are reversing the obesity epidemic at population scale.
but population impact is gated by adherence and access.

whatchanged.footer: The real-world number forced a more honest claim, the edit is the work.
